P0081.label: Link-side torque sensor flexure
P0081.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Strain-gauge torque sensor between gear output and link. Franka lists "link-side torque sensors in all 7 axes"; libfranka reports them as τ_J. Spoke count is representative. Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0082.label: Strain gauges
P0082.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Gauge positions are representative. Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0083.label: Reduction gearbox (type not published)
P0083.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Franka's joint patent places "a gearbox … behind the electric motor and the locking device" but does not name the gear type, so this ring stands in for an unpublished design. Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0084.label: Motor stator
P0084.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Joint motor (electric motor 16 in US10357886B2). Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0085.label: Stator windings
P0085.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Copper windings; the patent can short-circuit them as a generator brake. Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0086.label: Rotor on drive shaft
P0086.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Rotor on the drive shaft that carries the star wheel. Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0087.label: Braking star (6 prongs)
P0087.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Star wheel on the drive shaft; when power drops a spring drives the head bolt between two prongs (form-fit lock). Patents name 5–6 prongs (US10357886B2) or 3 webs (US11999056B2, 42CrMo4 sheet ≤ 2 mm). Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0088.label: Bearing disc
P0088.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Stationary bearing disc fixed to the housing; supports the drive shaft and carries the bolt actuator. Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0089.label: Locking solenoid (magnet actuator)
P0089.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Holds the head bolt back while powered; iFixit shows it fixed by 4 × M2 screws with a 2-pin connector to the main PCB. Arrangement follows Franka patents and libfranka; sizes are scaled to the housing in the official mesh, not Franka data.

P0090.label: Head bolt (bronze locking pin)
P0090.note: A1 · Base (87.0 N·m class). Spring-driven bolt that drops into the star wheel; iFixit identifies a bronze pin that should rise and stay up on unlock. facts: Joint torque limits: 87 N·m (A1–A4), 12 N·m (A5–A7); velocity 2.175 / 2.61 rad/s (franka_description).
Link-side torque sensors in all 7 axes; libfranka reports motor position θ separately from link position q.
Flange DIN ISO 9409-1-A50, measured in the official mesh: 4 × M6 on Ø50, Ø31.5 centring bore, Ø6 pin hole.
Base: 4 × Ø9 holes for M8 at 30 N·m, 2 × Ø6 H7 pin holes 134 mm apart, M5 earth thread.
Franka Hand: 2 × M6×12 DIN 7984 at 5 N·m; fingers 2 × M4×12 each at 2.25 N·m; 80 mm stroke.
